column1: Supplementary Table 13: Descriptive cardiac resilience index
Each row is one genotype–age mean under the high-dose challenge (10^9 CFU/mL). CBTB and CZTB are centred and divided by their sample standard deviations across the six groups.

PRI_H (H, high dose) is the first principal component, oriented towards later cardiac decline and arrest. Equal positive loadings give PRI_H = (z_CBTB + z_CZTB)/sqrt(2). The index is a group-level descriptive summary.
Source: supplied six-group cardiac means (Source Data, Current_Cardiac_Means).
